mechanism: Power spectrum of short-term AR process: positive AR coefficient concentrates energy at low frequencies (decaying spectrum); negative AR shifts energy to high frequencies (rising spectrum). Guides AR order/sign inference from spectral shape.
data_needed: Differenced or raw returns series; Welch-windowed DFT power spectrum.

mechanism: Build cumulative power; compare to white-noise expectation i/(m_cases−1); CSD_i = cum_frac − expected_frac. Max |CSD| vs Kolmogorov–Smirnov D (q=n/2−1, ×0.72 if Welch windowed) tests residual whiteness—flat residuals = good model; left/right CSD skew = low/high-frequency leftover structure.
data_needed: Model residuals or raw series; DFT power; significance alpha for D statistic.
